rule: Archetypes are evaluated only when a causal trigger, scheduled process, or relevant settlement requires them. They are not polled daily.

archetypes.pressure: Academy team assignment requires an actual scene and cannot be skipped into an already-established team relationship.

archetypes.trigger: Wei ANBU candidacy reaches a lawful review, trial, invitation, or crisis-driven evaluation
archetypes.pressure: May advance or reject Wei; never auto-activates the future six-person squad.

archetypes.trigger: Wei generates sufficient observable threat, inquiry, contact, or evidence around Root
archetypes.pressure: Root may investigate, misdirect, recruit, isolate, surveil, or prepare defenses using knowledge.

archetypes.trigger: Root suffers a leak, missing asset, compromised operative, or credible intrusion warning
archetypes.pressure: Security changes must be committed before any later battle snapshot.

archetypes.trigger: border threat score rises from actual incidents, reports, or force movement
archetypes.pressure: Creates reconnaissance, escort, protection, or reinforcement demand.

archetypes.trigger: trade route safety or throughput materially deteriorates
archetypes.pressure: Raises escort, investigation, suppression, or route-clearing demand.

archetypes.trigger: multiple verified missing-nin incidents or a high-value target enters accessible markets
archetypes.pressure: Bounty information and capture competition intensify.

archetypes.trigger: Kiri identifies a missing-nin, stolen secret, or sensitive target requiring recovery
archetypes.pressure: Kiri deploys hunter capability through normal travel, authority, and mission procedures.
Can alter patrols, intelligence priorities, and force posture.

archetypes.trigger: Iwa receives a material fortification, siege, route-denial, or disaster requirement
archetypes.pressure: Commits existing engineers and Earth specialists; creates no new manpower.

archetypes.trigger: Suna funding, mission demand, or security situation materially changes
archetypes.pressure: Can shift specialist availability and mission-market competition.

archetypes.trigger: a experiment, prisoner, operative, or project escapes or is compromised
archetypes.pressure: Creates retrieval, concealment, or external-security consequences.

archetypes.trigger: Ame leadership detects a credible internal or external security threat
archetypes.pressure: Checkpoints, surveillance, patrols, and intelligence actions change using existing forces.

archetypes.trigger: casualty intake exceeds current medical throughput
archetypes.pressure: Treatment queues and staffing availability become material.

archetypes.trigger: a clan duty, security issue, marriage/family concern, or Byakugan threat becomes material
archetypes.pressure: Creates social, training, security, or political obligations without forcing Riku or Wei decisions.
